title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Hariyama 025/063 Mega Brave Foil Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Japanese Mega Battle Pokemon card featuring the character Hariyama. This altered art card is part of the MEGA set with a Fighting attribute and a rare rarity. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2025, this standard-sized card is designed for the Pokemon TCG game and is a must-have for collectors and fans of the Pokemon franchise. Made of paper with a foil finish, this unique card is a valuable addition to any collection.
